# edh-d-2 (Commander EDHREC ranks 11,251-12,500): return a card from the graveyard tapped with N counters, search another player's library into their graveyard, optional "sacrifice any number of creatures / exile any number of creature cards from your graveyard" cost reductions, the exiled-with random card to its owner's hand, a life total set to half the starting life total, mill then may put a card from among them onto the battlefield, reveal your hand and put all lands, "return it" after a counter cost.
